title: 細雨飄落於波西米亞平原
source: 細雨飄落於波西米亞平原.docx

flow.zh:
細雨飄落於波西米亞平原
Karlovy  Vary,   Czech  Republic

zh: 離開維也納，北上進入捷克南邊的波西米亞平原。時值暮春，從Cesky Krumlov 到Karlovy Vary，一路細雨，飄落於廣裘原野，飄落於一畝一畝油菜花田，金黄色的花田，時而阡陌迤邐，無涯無際，時而與農田，農舍錯落，黄綠相間，構成美的幾何圖様。煙雨飄渺中，有詩意也有感動……
en: Leaving Vienna, we headed north into the Bohemian plain of southern Czechia. It was late spring, and from Cesky Krumlov to Karlovy Vary, a fine rain fell all the way, drifting down over the vast open fields, drifting down over field after field of canola. The golden blossoms stretched sometimes in endless, boundless rows, and sometimes scattered among farmhouses and cropland, yellow and green interwoven into beautiful geometric patterns. Amid the misting rain, there was poetry, and there was feeling……

zh: 阿爾卑斯山的雪峯峻嶺
奧匈帝國波瀾洶湧的歷史
en: Past Innsbruck, Austria
The snow peaks and towering ridges of the Alps
The turbulent history of the Austro-Hungarian Empire
Gradually settling into
The emerald plains of Bohemia
Tranquil, gently beautiful

zh: 另一片溫馨的海島風景……
en: Late spring, the month of May
Endless fine rain falls upon
The vast, hazy plains of Bohemia
Mist and haze, blurred and faint
Fields of rapeseed flowers unfold, stretching on and on
A golden hue
A collaged pattern
Drawing out a drifting mood
Flowing beyond time and space
Another warm island scene……

zh: 雖說冬天是蕭索的，在婆娑之洋，美麗之島，卻也有一番金黄溫潤的景色。不管是豐收還是歉收，二期稻作收割後，翻起的土地就像翻出一幅幅不同的鄉野風景。許多農夫在翻開的田地，遍灑油菜花種。無視於風寒雨冷，地凍土寂，花種兀自萌芽，成長，含苞，隨後綻放出一蕊蕊小黄花，延展出一畝畝金黄油菜花田。從嘉南平原到花東縱谷，以阡陌艷麗的色彩，歡悦的圖案，掩蓋著大地的蕭索，爲更豐盛的來年做準備。
en: Although winter is said to be bleak, on this ocean of swaying waves, this beautiful island, there is nonetheless a scene of golden, mellow warmth. Whether the harvest is bountiful or lean, once the second rice crop is reaped, the turned-over soil reveals field after field of differing rural scenery. Many farmers scatter canola seed across the freshly turned earth. Undeterred by the cold wind and chilling rain, by frozen ground and silent soil, the seeds sprout on their own, grow, bud, and then burst into countless small yellow blossoms, unfurling into acre upon acre of golden canola fields. From the Chianan Plain to the Huadong Valley, with the vivid colors and joyful patterns of the paddies, they cover over the earth's bleakness, preparing for a more abundant year to come.
Just like this

zh: 波西米亞平原領我回鄉
en: The Bohemian plain leads me home
Returning to the familiar Chianan Plain
The soft rain of spring
Mountains stretching on without end
The understated countryside
Fresh air

zh: 只要多觀察      就能測知土地豐沛的靈氣
只要多参與      就能感受人民鮮活的氣息
只要多閱讀      就能看見土地多姿的神采
只要多關懷      就能體會人民純樸的心意
波西米亞金黄的色澤將盡
en: So it turns out
Every patch of land
Each has its own distinct pulse
Every group of people
Each has a song sung in its praise
Just observe more, and you can sense the land's abundant spirit
Just take part more, and you can feel the people's living breath
Just read more, and you can see the land's manifold splendor
Just care more, and you can feel the people's simple, honest heart
Tomorrow
The fine rain is about to stop
Bohemia's golden hue is nearly spent
Prague, drawing nearer step by step
What kind of scenery would it be?
Tomorrow
Farther still
The beautiful island where the four seasons alternate
What kind of face will it show?

flow.caption_zh: 暮春五月油菜花田。㨗克西南部波西米亞平原。(攝影/何康隆)

zh: 波西米亞 (捷克語，Cechy ;  拉丁語，Bohemia ) 有地理，歷史和文化的涵意。就歷史而言，波西米亞王國是古中歐國家，曾經是神聖羅馬帝國中的一個王國，隨後成爲奥地利哈布斯堡王朝的一省。1919年至1992年間曾斷續屬於捷克斯洛伐克的一部分，1993年之後成爲捷克共和國的主要部分。就文化而言，波西米亞是指波西米亞風格，是一種藝術家氣質，一種小資優雅情調，一種反傳統，隨性，浪漫的生活模式和時尚潮流。19世紀法國作家 Henri  Murger 寫了一本小說《波西米亞人的生活情景》，而有了波西米亞人的名稱和涵義。意大利歌劇作家普契尼根據該小說，創作了經典歌劇「波希米亞人」(La Boheme，又譯爲藝術家的生涯，1896年)。就地理而言，波西米亞地處歐洲大陸中心的波西米亞平原，主要是捷克中西部大片土地 (包括首都布拉格 ) 以及鄰接的德國，波蘭和奥地利小部份。有遼濶起伏的山丘森林風景，多變且充满活力的人文氣息。是流浪民族吉普賽人的聚集地。境内有捷克的最長河流伏爾塔瓦河 ( the Vltava )，自西南經Cesky Krumlov 往北流經布拉格，穿過查理大橋，北上注入易北河。
en: Bohemia (Czech: Čechy; Latin: Bohemia) carries geographic, historical, and cultural meaning. Historically, the Kingdom of Bohemia was an ancient Central European state, once a kingdom within the Holy Roman Empire, later becoming a province of the Austrian Habsburg monarchy. Between 1919 and 1992 it was, intermittently, part of Czechoslovakia, and after 1993 it became the core of the Czech Republic. Culturally, Bohemia refers to the Bohemian style — an artistic temperament, a refined, faintly decadent elegance, an anti-traditional, free-spirited, romantic way of life and fashion. In the 19th century the French writer Henri Murger wrote a novel, Scenes of Bohemian Life, from which the name and meaning of Bohemian arose. The Italian opera composer Puccini, based on that novel, created the classic opera La Bohème (also translated as The Life of an Artist, 1896). Geographically, Bohemia lies in the Bohemian Plain at the heart of the European continent, comprising mainly the broad lands of west-central Czechia (including the capital, Prague) along with small adjoining parts of Germany, Poland, and Austria. It has a landscape of sweeping, rolling hills and forests, and a varied, vibrant human character. It is a gathering place of the wandering Roma people. Within its borders runs the Czech Republic's longest river, the Vltava, which flows from the southwest through Český Krumlov, north through Prague, under the Charles Bridge, and onward north into the Elbe.

zh: Cesky Krumlov 和Karlovy Vary 是捷克波西米亞平原上的主要旅遊勝地。Cesky Krumlov ( 河灣中的淺灘 ) 座落於伏爾塔瓦河彎曲流過的深谷中，是童話般的美麗小城。14世紀以來，經羅森堡家族和哈布斯堡王朝的經營，在豐富的藝術涵養下，城堡建築以文藝復興風格爲主調，配上巴洛可和洛可可情調，使臨河城鎮雖迷你但精緻，古典而高雅，城堡，廣埸，窄巷等都點綴著柔麗的色彩，散發著寧静的懷古氣氛， 是座經歷史薰染而被時間遺忘的詩意小城，走在民風純樸的街巷，有如流連於一則故事，一段夢境。1992年列入UNESCO 人類遺產名錄。
en: Cesky Krumlov and Karlovy Vary are the main tourist destinations on the Bohemian plain of the Czech Republic. Cesky Krumlov (a shallow shoal in a river bend) sits in a deep valley through which the Vltava River winds, a fairy-tale-like beautiful small town. Since the 14th century, developed under the Rosenberg family and the Habsburg dynasty, its castle architecture is grounded in the Renaissance style, layered with Baroque and Rococo flourishes, making the riverside town, though miniature, exquisite -- classical yet elegant. The castle, the square, the narrow lanes are all touched with soft, lovely colors, exuding a quiet, nostalgic atmosphere. It is a poetic small town steeped in history yet forgotten by time; walking its simple, unassuming streets and alleys feels like lingering inside a story, a dream. It was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage list in 1992.

zh: Karlovy Vary 位於捷克西部，距布拉格約二個小時車程。坐落於溫泉水源地區，是着名的溫泉小城。城内有13個主要温泉，三百多個小溫泉。遊人可隨時掬飲自動流瀉的泉水。溫泉杯＋溫泉餅＋溫泉酒＝溫泉鄉。此城德語爲Karlsbad，得名於神聖羅馬帝國皇帝，波西米亞國王卡爾四世，他在1370年建立城市。Karlsbad中的bad字根就是德語溫泉之意。歷來是皇宫貴族休閒埸所，更多的文人音樂家如歌德，席勒，貝多芬，莫札特，舒曼，柴可夫斯基等，都曾留下足跡。城郊有他們塑像的小公園。城中有捷克作曲家德沃夏克(Antonin Dvorak)的彫像花園，散發著其作品新世界交響樂繁豊旋律之美。Karlovy Vary雖然也有河流貫穿，但景緻風格和童話般的Cesky  Krumlov不同，它的市容整齊，色彩華麗高雅，成熟而端莊，古典又時潮，又是環球五大影展所在之一。
en: Karlovy Vary lies in the western Czech Republic, about a two-hour drive from Prague. Situated in a region of hot spring waters, it is a famous spa town. Within the city there are 13 major hot springs and more than three hundred smaller ones; visitors may drink the freely flowing spring water at any time. Spa cup, plus spa wafer, plus spa liqueur, equals a spa town. In German the city is called Karlsbad, named for the Holy Roman Emperor and King of Bohemia, Charles IV, who founded the city in 1370. The "bad" in Karlsbad is the German root for hot spring. It has long been a resort for royalty and nobility, and many writers and musicians -- Goethe, Schiller, Beethoven, Mozart, Schumann, Tchaikovsky, and others -- left their footsteps here. On the town's outskirts is a small park with their statues. In the town there is also a statue garden for the Czech composer Antonin Dvorak, radiating the rich melodic beauty of his "New World Symphony." Though Karlovy Vary is likewise threaded by a river, its scenery and style differ from the fairy-tale Cesky Krumlov -- its townscape is orderly, its colors resplendent and elegant, mature and dignified, classical yet fashionable, and it is also home to one of the world's five major film festivals.

flow.caption_zh: 台灣台東池上冬天的油菜花田。 (網路照片)

zh: 從台東縣鹿野，關山，池上，到花蓮縣富里，玉里，壽豐，綿延近百里的這段地區，是花東縱谷的稻米栽培區。由於水質與土壤淨潔無污染，出產晶瑩透剔的白米，煮起來旣柔軟有黏彈性，又散發出一股淡淡香味，品質獨步全台。這一片綠油油的稻田景緻，在每年12月至次年1，2月份冬季休耕期間，農民就在田裡種油菜，做爲有機綠色肥料。因此1月中旬起，盛開的大片油菜花海，成爲花東縱谷極爲迷人的風景。一朵朵小黄花雖不起眼，但是當油菜花田一畦接一畦，綿延到天際，就是一片金黄燦爛的壯觀景象，應著藍天白雲，青山绿水，襯托出脱塵離俗的田園風光，成爲花東縱谷的獨特風景。爲了讓冬天的縱谷景觀更加多彩多姿，近年來有些農民開始改種色彩絢麗的波斯菊，營造更多樣的花海景色，以帶動更活耀的觀光時潮。
en: From Luye, Guanshan, and Chishang in Taitung County, to Fuli, Yuli, and Shoufeng in Hualien County, this stretch of nearly a hundred miles is the rice-growing region of the East Rift Valley. Because the water and soil are pure and unpolluted, it yields glistening, translucent white rice that, once cooked, is soft and pleasantly sticky, with a faint fragrance — its quality unmatched anywhere in Taiwan. Across this lush green expanse of paddies, during the winter fallow season from December through January and February, farmers plant canola in the fields as organic green fertilizer. So from mid-January on, the vast blooming sea of canola flowers becomes one of the East Rift Valley's most enchanting sights. Each small yellow flower is unremarkable alone, but when the canola fields stretch field after field to the horizon, they form a magnificent expanse of golden brilliance, set against blue sky and white clouds, green mountains and clear water — a pastoral scene of transcendent beauty that has become the East Rift Valley's signature landscape. To make the valley's winter scenery even more vibrant, in recent years some farmers have begun planting the vividly colored cosmos as well, creating a more varied sea of flowers to draw an even livelier tide of visitors.

points.zh: 「油菜花籽命」，是指早時女人的命運就像油菜花籽一般，隨風而定，隨運而生，飄到那裡就長在那裡。有嫁雞隨雞，嫁狗隨狗，任命運擺佈，屈服環境的意思。油菜花 (Rape flower, Rapeseed flower)又名菜籽或油菜籽，是十字花科植物，耐寒，耐旱，耐鹽，耐濕，環境適應力强。因此也用「菜籽命」來形容吃苦耐勞的女人，指認女人順應環境，落地生根的堅强靭性。廖輝英的成名小說「油麻菜籽」(1982)，對「查某人菜籽命」有深刻的闡釋。該小說被譽爲「一筆寫盡台灣婦女三十年悲苦生活」，是台灣女性成長的珍貴記錄，女性主義風潮的先鋒，開啓女性自覺的時代，影響女性掙脱傳統命運的抉擇。
